regulatory_requirement_summary: Primary responsibilities for licensee, state, local and supporting organizations are assigned; principal response organizations can augment initial response continuously.
required_local_evidence: signed responsibility matrix;state/local/tribal MOUs;24-7 augmentation roster;role-to-contact table;backup public-information staffing
minimum_readiness_proof: roles are assigned, contactable, exercised, and backed by alternates
common_failure_mode: paper roles without staffed alternates or offsite agreement

regulatory_requirement_summary: On-shift emergency response responsibilities are unambiguous, initial accident response staffing is maintained, timely augmentation is available, and onsite/offsite interfaces are specified.
required_local_evidence: minimum staffing analysis;shift roster;augmentation callout drill;interface procedure;fatigue controls
minimum_readiness_proof: initial and augmented response can be demonstrated under off-hours and degraded-communications conditions
common_failure_mode: unexercised augmentation or single-point staffing fragility

planning_standard_short: Assistance resources and emergency operations interfaces
regulatory_requirement_summary: Assistance-resource request paths, state/local staff accommodation at emergency operations facilities, and organizations capable of augmentation are identified.
required_local_evidence: mutual-aid agreements;resource typing;EOF/EOC seating and communications test;request protocol;logistics staging plan
minimum_readiness_proof: resource request, receipt, and integration are exercised with offsite partners
common_failure_mode: mutual-aid names exist but deployability is unknown

regulatory_requirement_summary: A standard emergency classification and action-level scheme is used, and offsite response plans rely on facility information for minimum initial offsite response measures.
required_local_evidence: EAL basis;classification drill;PAR handoff log;dose-projection workflow;offsite authority acknowledgement
minimum_readiness_proof: classification, PAR generation, and offsite handoff are rehearsed and timed
common_failure_mode: classification scheme exists but PAR authority handoff is ambiguous

regulatory_requirement_summary: Procedures establish notification of response organizations and emergency personnel, message content, and early notification plus clear instruction to the plume EPZ population.
required_local_evidence: sirens/EAS/WEA/phone/door-to-door test results;message templates;language and disability access test;public instructions version control
minimum_readiness_proof: reachable population is tested across redundant channels and instructions are clear
common_failure_mode: notification channel passes technical test but vulnerable groups are missed

regulatory_requirement_summary: Prompt communications exist among principal response organizations, emergency personnel, and the public.
required_local_evidence: communications drill;backup radio/satellite/landline inventory;message acknowledgment log;public communication protocol
minimum_readiness_proof: principal organizations can communicate under outage, congestion, and cyber-degraded conditions
common_failure_mode: single communication path or untested backup

regulatory_requirement_summary: Public emergency information is provided periodically; media contact points and coordinated public dissemination procedures are pre-established.
required_local_evidence: annual public information materials;PIO roster;JIC protocol;rumor/counterevidence channel;accessible public maps
minimum_readiness_proof: public knows notification methods and initial actions; PIO/JIC procedures are exercised
common_failure_mode: public brochure exists but no live coordination or counterevidence path

regulatory_requirement_summary: Adequate emergency facilities and equipment to support emergency response are provided and maintained.
required_local_evidence: facility readiness checklist;backup facility test;instrument calibration;PPE/dosimetry inventory;maintenance records
minimum_readiness_proof: equipment and facilities are maintained, calibrated, and exercised
common_failure_mode: equipment exists but calibration, access, or backup facility readiness is stale

regulatory_requirement_summary: Adequate methods, systems, and equipment are used to assess and monitor actual or potential offsite consequences.
required_local_evidence: field monitoring deployment plan;dose projection model;instrument calibration;data integration;public dashboard redaction boundary
minimum_readiness_proof: measurements, projections, and protective-action feedback are exercised together
common_failure_mode: dose model and field monitoring are not reconciled

planning_standard_short: Protective actions for plume and ingestion EPZs
regulatory_requirement_summary: A range of protective actions exists for emergency workers and the public, including evacuation, sheltering, KI as a supplement where appropriate, evacuation-time estimates, federal-guidance-consistent choices, and ingestion-pathway actions.
required_local_evidence: ETE;route model;transportation assistance plan;shelter protocol;KI decision/dosing path;food/water interdiction plan;special-population annexes
minimum_readiness_proof: protective action choices are locally executable and exercised under realistic constraints
common_failure_mode: KI, evacuation, or sheltering treated as a substitute for the other actions

regulatory_requirement_summary: Means for controlling radiological exposures are established for emergency workers and include exposure guidelines consistent with EPA PAGs.
required_local_evidence: emergency worker dose limits;dosimetry issue/return logs;PPE and contamination-control training;fatigue controls;turnback criteria
minimum_readiness_proof: workers can perform lifesaving and critical tasks with dose tracking and protective equipment
common_failure_mode: worker exposure controls are generic occupational rules not emergency-ready

planning_standard_short: Medical services for contaminated injured individuals
regulatory_requirement_summary: Arrangements are made for medical services for contaminated injured individuals.
required_local_evidence: hospital coalition agreement;ambulance contamination protocol;decon corridor;triage training;special-population transfer plan
minimum_readiness_proof: contaminated injured patients can be transported, received, decontaminated, treated, and tracked
common_failure_mode: hospital named but first receivers, privacy, and surge not exercised

regulatory_requirement_summary: General plans for recovery and reentry are developed.
required_local_evidence: reentry criteria;relocation support;cleanup planning;alternate water/food plan;claims access;mental health and benefits continuity;counterevidence closure
minimum_readiness_proof: recovery decisions can be made with public-health, housing, cleanup, claims and communication capacity

planning_standard_short: Exercises, drills, and correction of deficiencies
regulatory_requirement_summary: Periodic exercises evaluate major emergency response capabilities; drills maintain key skills; deficiencies from exercises or drills are corrected.
required_local_evidence: exercise schedule;scenario injects;AAR/IP;deficiency owner/due date;closure evidence;retest result when material
minimum_readiness_proof: findings are corrected, not merely observed
common_failure_mode: biennial exercise completed but deficiencies remain open or unretired

regulatory_requirement_summary: Training is provided to those who may be called on to assist in an emergency.
required_local_evidence: training matrix;credential records;refresher cadence;role-specific drill participation;mutual-aid onboarding
minimum_readiness_proof: assist organizations know radiological hazards, tasks, communications, and handoff procedures
common_failure_mode: generic ICS training substituted for radiological role training

planning_standard_short: Plan development, review, distribution, and planner training
regulatory_requirement_summary: Responsibilities for emergency plan development, review, distribution, and planner training are established.
required_local_evidence: plan owner;review calendar;distribution list;revision control;planner training;public redaction and counterevidence process
minimum_readiness_proof: current plans reach responsible organizations and planners are trained before changes go live
common_failure_mode: stale or undistributed plan still counted as current
